items.title: Sizing now = f(target, survival) — target drives, survival is a hard cap
items.note: Your correction 2026-08-15: sizing serves the 1%/week target, clamped by the risk-of-ruin ceiling (never crossed). REVERSES Phase-5's 'no target param' invariant → needs a Phase-5 sizing amendment. Requirements PORT-03 + WEEK-04 updated.

items.title: NO zero-trade weeks — build & exit a fresh portfolio every week
items.note: Your correction: always a book; weak weeks deploy smaller (survival cap), never zero. REVERSES Phase-5's 'zero-trade weeks allowed'. Requirement WEEK-01/03 added.

items.title: Theses on EVERY name every week (not just catalysts)
items.note: Your correction: mean-reversion ('dropped last week, is the bounce a proven edge?') + continuation + catalyst, each with a measured historical edge. New capability upstream of the trade builder — WEEK-02. Will need a new phase/expansion before the backtest.

items.title: Hedging default is a naked, survival-sized single leg
items.note: 3 research passes proved clean long-only idiosyncratic hedges are rare; pairs used only when re-validated per-catalyst. Confirm you're comfortable with this being the default.

items.title: Book-level 1% aggregation (being amended by the sizing correction above)
items.note: Original: legs sized survival-first, select_book aggregates toward ~1% by selection only. The correction makes sizing target-driven-within-cap; this gets reworked in the Phase-5 sizing amendment.

items.title: Options-implied move sourced FREE from CBOE delayed-quotes JSON
items.note: No paid feed needed. Behind a pluggable seam; degrades to in-house gap estimator on illiquid names. Web-scraper is a build-our-own (shared repo was do-not-fork: no license, stale).

items.title: Pending from you: curate seed universe + PDUFA dates
items.note: Templates shipped in data/. System runs on stubs until real catalysts are curated — needed before the paper phase.

items.title: New validated hedge pairs found
items.note: CYTK/EWTX (HCM, the second IONS/BBIO), BMRN/ASND, UTHR/LQDA + inverse-ETF dampers LABD/RWM/TZA/SPDN. Seed data for the per-trade validator, loaded at universe curation.

items.title: Backtest must simulate data-gathering timing (Phase 7)
items.note: Data-latency knob beside the slippage knob; point-in-time only, no look-ahead on delayed free data. Logged.

items.title: Faster/more-deterministic fetch = deferred optimization
items.note: Current ~5-min/EOD cadence is fine for a week-hold; revisit after the backtest baseline.
